note: Ground truth for FixtureQA and scoring. Not shown during the demo. App #2 for the cross-org transfer beat (AMENDMENT-03): J-01 and J-02 share the modal-state-not-reset class with Tasker (org acme) but wear completely different symptoms.

bugs.symptom: After cancelling one share dialog, sharing a different note sends the invite for the FIRST note — the dialog header names the wrong note and the recipient is granted access to a note the user never chose. Privacy breach.
repro: Click Share on 'Call plumber re: kitchen tap'
Click Cancel (✕ or Cancel button)
Click Share on 'Q3 headcount notes'
Observe: dialog reads 'Sharing “Call plumber re: kitchen tap”'
Enter an email, click Send invite — the invite attaches to the plumber note
bugs.root_cause: openShare() seeds the scratch object with `shareCtx = shareCtx || {noteId, title}`, so it only initialises when null. The dismiss path (closeDialog) never nulls shareCtx; only sendShare() clears it. A cancelled share leaves the stale target alive for the next open.

bugs.symptom: A tag you typed and then cancelled resurrects: reopening the tag manager shows the discarded name and color, and clicking Create makes the ghost tag you decided not to create.
repro: Click 'Manage tags…', type 'temp-tag', pick Rose
Click Cancel
Click 'Manage tags…' again
Observe: 'temp-tag' and Rose are pre-filled as if never discarded
Click Create tag — the discarded tag is created
bugs.root_cause: openTags() seeds `tagDraft = tagDraft || {name:'', color:'amber'}`; the dismiss path never nulls tagDraft, only createTag() does. Identical latent defect to J-01: lazily-seeded dialog scratch state that close-without-confirm never clears.

bugs.symptom: Search is case-sensitive: searching 'miso' finds the recipe, searching 'Miso' with a different case than the note text finds nothing. Lowercase queries miss capitalised titles.
repro: Switch to the Recipes notebook
Type 'miso' in search — the eggplant note matches (body contains 'miso')
Type 'MISO' — no results, #no-notes shows
bugs.root_cause: visible() filters with raw String.indexOf on title and body, no case normalisation on either side.

bugs.symptom: The '<n> notes in <notebook>' pill does not update when a note is removed — it only corrects itself after an unrelated action like saving a note or switching notebooks.
repro: Note the count pill (e.g. '2 notes in Work')
Click Remove on a Work note
Observe: the grid loses the card but the pill still says 2
bugs.root_cause: removeNote() calls persist() and renderNotes() but not renderCount(); saveNote() calls all three. Asymmetric re-render of derived state.

bugs.symptom: Clicking ANY notebook in the sidebar empties the note grid and deselects every notebook. The app appears to lose all notes until reload.
repro: Click 'Work' (or any notebook) in the left rail
Observe: grid goes empty, no notebook is highlighted, count pill reads 'undefined'
bugs.root_cause: renderNotebooks() binds click handlers inside a `for (var i ...)` loop and the handler reads notebooks[i] at click time. By then i === notebooks.length, so currentNotebook becomes undefined and nothing matches it.

bugs.symptom: Markup typed into a note title is rendered, not displayed: a title containing 'x' shows bold text, and an title executes script. Stored XSS via note titles.
repro: Create a new note titled:
Save it
Observe: the browser tab title changes to 'pwned' — the payload executed
bugs.root_cause:
renderNotes() builds each card with card.innerHTML = '

' + n.title + '

' — user-controlled title concatenated into HTML unescaped (body uses textContent and is safe; the title path is not).
